## About
Indianapolis Auto Parts is your local source for quality recycled auto parts, right on N. Raceway Rd on the west side of Indianapolis.
We're now under new ownership. You can search our inventory online, search by image, or use our multi-part search. Prefer to talk it through? Call or stop by the sales department and we'll help you track down what you need.

## Services
- Quality recycled auto parts: Used parts for drivers in the Indianapolis area. Search online, call, or stop by the sales department.
- 30 and 90 day warranties: We offer 30 and 90 day warranties as part of our service.
- UPS and FedEx shipping: Can't make it to Raceway Rd? We ship parts with UPS and FedEx.

## FAQ
Q: What if I don't see my part in your online inventory?
A: Give us a call at 317-925-8520 and we'll find it for you.

Q: Can you ship a part to me?
A: Yes. We offer shipping through UPS and FedEx.
